articles.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
articles.snippet: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

articles.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
articles.snippet: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

articles.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
articles.snippet: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.
